title: Voices at the wedding hall
body:
Read the extract from the wedding reception in 'A Wedding in Brownsville' and answer the questions.

'My father? He was killed. They were all killed. I'm the only one left of the entire family.' ... 'Do you see that young woman dancing in the yellow dress? It's Riva's sister... Riva herself? Where all the others ended up: Auschwitz. How close we came ourselves! All of us are really dead, if you want to call it that. We were exterminated, wiped out. Even the survivors carry death in the hearts. But it's a wedding, we should be cheerful.' ... 'What is life anyway? A dance on the grave.' 'Yes, but as long as you're playing the game, you have to abide by the rules.'
